robot_task: OpenArm left-arm cube pick and place

admission.provenance: Inherited conservative admission model from production-capacity run.py and openarm-throughput-benchmark; not a measured hardware minimum.

stages.question: Can the full production pipeline complete and close files with 24 active environments?
acceptance: 24 actual environments; exact fixed attempt count and unique per-run accounting
No OOM, infrastructure errors, missing shards or incomplete exports
Read back all recorded numeric arrays and all RGB chunks; validate shape, finite values and frame counts
Independently apply existing strict terminal predicate to every success
Report task failures in denominator; no success-rate acceptance threshold inferred from this pilot

stages.question: What XY perturbation range can the current SkillGen production generator cover?
stages.controls: Freeze source demonstration, robot, cameras, dynamics, target pad, z and orientation. Pair normalized XY samples across ranges, record actual initial states and verify them independently. Wide range is a stress condition, not an approved production distribution.
stages.primary_metric: Strictly accepted and file-validated episodes / all valid attempts, separately per condition and seed
stages.invalid_initial_states: Record geometry/reachability exclusions and their denominator separately; never silently resample.

stages.question: Can appearance randomization preserve physical production while changing useful camera observations?
stages.controls: Use the accepted pose domain and exact paired initial states; freeze camera extrinsics/intrinsics, controller, mass, friction and restitution. Appearance material must preserve physics material bindings.
stages.entry_gate: Calibrate and freeze OpenArm-specific lighting/material ranges in a separate pilot before formal trials; existing G1 ranges are not automatically accepted.
stages.primary_metric: Strict acceptance and file validity by condition; image change is auxiliary evidence, not policy generalization

stages.entry_gate: Implement and verify a shared OpenArm action interface, common contacts/planning budget, exact reset-state replay and stage labels; pre-register budget before starting.
stages.controls: 24 environments for each arm of comparison; identical initial-state manifest, source skills, observation streams, attempt count and success predicate.
stages.primary_metric: Accepted data yield, coverage and cost on the common state set; report adaptation costs separately

stages.entry_gate: Select an existing compatible model/checkpoint and action/observation interface, validate loader timing, fix training budget and splits before training; do not install dependencies automatically.
stages.controls: Equal accepted trajectory count and updates; group all appearance variants of an underlying trajectory in one split.
stages.primary_metric: Full-episode policy success on paired held-out states, separately by training seed and test domain

evidence_rules: A passed preflight permits only a queued qualification attempt; it is not simulation validation.
All simulation, training and resource-intensive readback uses the same host-local task queue.
Never mix telemetry from different run_id values or reuse an output path.
Infrastructure errors stop the affected experiment; retain failures, partial outputs and provenance.
Do not merge historical speed results with capability success rates.
Do not call SkillGen and SkillMimicGen interchangeable without verifying implementation and interface provenance.
